stages.prompt: Implement the supplied Nitely feature specification and technical design. Add or update focused tests for the requested behavior, keep the change scoped, update docs when behavior changes, and avoid weakening existing tests. Produce a concise implementation summary and one-line pr-title artifact.

stages.command: pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm run check && pnpm run build

stages.prompt: Review the implementation against the specification and technical design. Check for missing tests, broken CLI contracts, unsafe filesystem behavior, and incomplete documentation. Write `Review verdict: pass` when there are no P0/P1/blocking findings. Write `Review verdict: fail` when any P0/P1/blocking issue exists, and list those findings first. Do not modify files during review.
